source.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ እሎንቱ፡ ለነገሥት፡ ወለኀያላን፡ ዘንቱ፡ ምድር፡ ከመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይትኀጐሉ።
source.note: Selected kings/powerful recipients and singular in-it pronoun retained; its antecedent is not silently identified or pluralized. No additional punisher or royal names supplied.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: English in-it keeps the selected singular construction; no unprinted plural by-them or fixed identification of valley/objects is adopted.

translation.text: He told me, “These are for the kings and the powerful of this earth, so that they may be destroyed in it.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected prepositional pronoun ቦቱ is singular. In it retains that relation without deciding whether the valley or a collective prepared object is the antecedent; it is not silently changed to plural by them. The plural recipients are the kings and powerful of this earth. No additional punisher, instrument name or royal roster is supplied.
